# Index Add and Remove Tests — verify index entry management

# --- Setup: initialize KB and write a note ---

exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the ones this scenario writes pages of.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .akb/templates/note.yaml
exec akb template get adr --full --examples
cp stdout .akb/templates/adr.yaml
exec git add .akb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed note and adr templates'

stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write test-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/test-note.md'

# --- Add entry to index ---

exec akb index add kb/notes/test-note.md 'Test summary'
stdout 'Added kb/notes/test-note.md to index'

# --- Show index contains the entry ---

exec akb index show
stdout '## Notes'
stdout 'Test Note'
stdout 'test-note.md'

# --- Add same path again updates, no duplicate ---

exec akb index add kb/notes/test-note.md 'Updated summary'
stdout 'Added kb/notes/test-note.md to index'

exec akb index show
stdout 'Updated summary'
! stdout 'Test summary'

# Count: only one entry line for test-note
exec akb index show
stdout 'test-note.md'

# --- Remove entry from index ---

exec akb index remove kb/notes/test-note.md
stdout 'Removed kb/notes/test-note.md from index'

exec akb index show
! stdout 'test-note.md'

# --- Remove nonexistent path succeeds silently ---

exec akb index remove kb/notes/nonexistent.md
stdout 'Removed kb/notes/nonexistent.md from index'

# --- Cannot add index.md to index ---

! exec akb index add kb/index.md 'Bad entry'
stderr 'cannot add index.md'

# --- Cannot add log.md to index ---

! exec akb index add kb/log.md 'Bad entry'
stderr 'cannot add log.md'

# --- Add ADR entry appears under Decisions heading ---

stdin ../adr-input.md
exec akb write test-decision.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/test-decision.md'

exec akb index add kb/decisions/test-decision.md 'Decision summary'
stdout 'Added kb/decisions/test-decision.md to index'

exec akb index show
stdout '## Adrs'
stdout 'Test Decision'

# --- Add note entry appears under Notes heading ---

stdin ../note2-input.md
exec akb write second-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/second-note.md'

exec akb index add kb/notes/second-note.md 'Second note summary'
stdout 'Added kb/notes/second-note.md to index'

exec akb index show
stdout '## Notes'
stdout 'Second Note'

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Test Note
summary: A test note for index
tags: test
---
Test note content.

-- note2-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Second Note
summary: Another test note
tags: test
---
Second note content.

-- adr-input.md --
---
type: adr
title: Test Decision
status: proposed
deciders: team
summary: A test decision
tags: [test]
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
## Context

ADR content. The index commands track a page by path, and a decision of this type is listed under its own heading in the rendered index. See [[test-note]] for the note that shares the same index.

## Decision

Decided. The decision is added to the index under the decisions heading.

## Consequences

Recorded. Removing the entry leaves the page on disk untouched.
